cases.prompt: A portrait-oriented editorial photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties with natural facial proportions, slightly asymmetrical features, visible pores and subtle skin texture. Frame her from chest up, looking slightly left of camera, with a softly blurred muted green interior behind her. The lighting must produce realistic shadows around the nose and jaw. Avoid airbrushed skin, plastic textures, over-sharpening, extra jewelry and exaggerated glamour.
